title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
好在它尝试了一下，这些杂草随着它能量的溢散，立马又会变得消失不见。而且，藤藤蛇觉得它的能量似乎还可以控制其他地方的植物。它顺着这种能量波动，闭上眼睛，尝试着将青草场地内不属于它的生命能量开始同化，让它们带上绿莹莹的能量波动。这种尝试并不慢，在五六秒之内，其他的杂草，就已经被青草场地同化，随即，在藤藤蛇的一念之下，周围30米以内的杂草，全部从地底剥离出来。“藤藤？”藤藤蛇睁开眼，出现在眼前的，是林枫啧啧称奇的目光，“学的挺快呀，我还在想，能不能让你的青草场地同化这里的其他植物，没想到还没说你就会了。”“藤藤～”藤藤蛇仰起头，一脸平淡的样子。只是出现在林枫心中的系统提示声音，暴露了它的心情。“那好，这样很快就能将整个种植园里面的杂草清理干净了。”林枫再次夸赞了一声后，将注意力放在了系统上。很显然，刚刚系统给予的奖励又是金坷拉和神奇糖果。经过这么多次的奖励，林枫也有了几点发现。首先，需要一次性将愉悦值提升十以上，才能触发系统的奖励机制。其次，每只宝可梦的第一次，似乎都会带上特殊奖励。像穿山鼠的土沙，丑丑鱼的生命果，藤藤蛇的特鳞果。一次性提升的愉悦值越多，奖励也就越丰富。比如收服藤藤蛇和丑丑鱼时候赠送的技能机和资质能量方块。特别是后者，能够提升宝可梦的资质！这在宝可梦培育界中，可不是一件易事。通常在涉及到神兽时，才有可能提升资质。虽然制造的原料有些贵了。但相较于神兽来说，能用钱买到的，问题就不是很大。而且系统还会奖励。比如生命果和特鳞果，都是制作资质提升能量方块的原料。只是侧重点不同。吃了生命果制造的能量方块，会在体力方面有显着的提升。吃了特鳞果制造的能量方块，则是在特攻方面有显着的提升。

看着努力“工作”的藤藤蛇，林枫的脸上，多了几分笑意。傲娇没关系，只要听话，干活就行了。“枫哥，枫哥，你在这里吗？”清脆的声音从外面响起，一道急匆匆的身影，推开种植园的栅栏门。林枫不用想，也知道是谁。这样的急性子，加上随便闯开他家的门，除了秦姝外，也不会有谁了。“怎么了？”林枫有些无奈的转过头来，只见穿着白色短袖，扎着丸子头的少女见到他后，眼睛顿时亮了起来。“我就知道你在这里，”秦姝进来后，先是在周围环顾了一眼，然后将目光落在了腾腾蛇身上，看着对方运用体内的能量，将杂草从根拔起，小嘴微张，表情逐渐变得不可思议起来，“藤藤蛇，这是什么操作？”“青草场地呀，怎么？上学的时候老师没讲过？”林枫白了她一眼，“还是说你根本没听？”“啊...这个，可能是还没学到这里来吧？”秦姝嘴角一抿，原本被太阳晒得有些红润的脸蛋，当即变得更加红了起来，尴尬的像是猴子的屁股。其实是上课根本没听讲。“呵呵…”林枫发出了两声无情的嘲笑声，随后问道，“说吧，什么事。”“嘻嘻，”少女连忙道，“就是，就是，枫哥，你不知道，班上有个很讨厌的男生，一直跟我不对付，暑假了，还天天缠着跟我发消息，我就跟他约了宝可梦对战，让他输了之后就不要给我发信息了。”“然后他说，要参加旺旺超市举办的宝宝杯，说要在那里争夺！”“但是他的宝可梦是草系的妙蛙种子，我有点怕打不过...”林枫打断了她，“所以，就要让我的藤藤蛇来帮忙训练你的杰尼龟？”“对对，”秦姝很认真的点头。“呃...”林枫毫不留情的吐槽道，“好幼稚的约战...”大概是那个男生喜欢秦姝，所以才会一直跟秦姝发信息。
content_en:
Fortunately, it gave it a try, and these weeds immediately disappeared as its energy overflowed.Moreover, the Vine Snake feels that its energy can also control plants in other places.It followed this energy fluctuation, closed its eyes, and tried to assimilate the life energy that did not belong to it in the grass field, making them carry green energy fluctuations.This attempt was not slow. Within five or six seconds, other weeds had been assimilated into the grass field. Then, with the thought of Vine Snake, all the weeds within 30 meters were peeled out from the ground."Vine?" Vine Snake opened his eyes, and what appeared in front of him was Lin Feng's amazed look. "You're a quick learner. I was still wondering if you could make your grass field assimilate other plants here. I didn't expect you would be able to do it before I told you." "Vine~" Vine Snake raised his head with a calm look on his face.Just the system prompt sound that appeared in Lin Feng's heart revealed its mood."Okay, then we can quickly clean up the weeds in the entire plantation." Lin Feng praised again and then focused on the system.Obviously, the rewards given by the system just now were Jin Jiaola and magical candies.After so many rewards, Lin Feng also made several discoveries.First of all, the pleasure value needs to be increased by more than ten at one time to trigger the system's reward mechanism.Secondly, each Pokémon’s first time seems to come with a special reward.Like the earthy sand of the pangolin, the life fruit of the ugly fish, and the special scale fruit of the vine snake.The more pleasure points you can increase at one time, the richer the rewards will be.For example, the skill machine and qualification energy cube will be given when you conquer the Vine Snake and Ugly Fish.Especially the latter, which can improve the Pokémon's qualifications!This is not an easy task in the world of Pokémon cultivation.It is usually possible to improve your qualifications when it comes to mythical beasts.Although the raw materials for manufacturing are a bit expensive.But compared to mythical beasts, which can be bought with money, the problem is not that big.And the system will reward you.For example, life fruit and special scale fruit are raw materials for making qualification-enhancing energy cubes.Just the focus is different.After eating the energy cubes produced by the Life Fruit, your physical strength will be significantly improved.After eating the energy cubes created by the special scale fruit, the special attack will be significantly improved.

Looking at Teng Teng Snake who was "working" hard, Lin Feng had a smile on his face.It doesn't matter if you are arrogant, as long as you are obedient and work hard."Brother Feng, Brother Feng, are you here?" A clear voice sounded from outside, and a hurried figure pushed open the fence gate of the plantation.Lin Feng knew who it was without having to think about it.With such an impatience and the fact that he casually broke into his door, there would be no one except Qin Shu."What's wrong?" Lin Feng turned around helplessly, and saw that the girl wearing white short-sleeves and a bun haircut, her eyes suddenly lit up when she saw him."I knew you were here." After Qin Shu came in, she first looked around, and then set her sights on Teng Teng Snake. She watched the other party use the energy in his body to pull up the weeds from the roots. His mouth opened slightly, and his expression gradually became incredible. "Teng Teng Snake, what is this operation?" "Green grass field."What? Didn't the teacher tell her when she was in school?"Lin Feng rolled his eyes at her, "Or did you not listen at all?""Ah... maybe you haven't learned this yet?"Qin Shu pursed her lips, and her face, which was originally rosy from the sun, immediately turned red, like a monkey's butt.In fact, I didn’t pay attention at all in class."Haha..." Lin Feng let out two ruthless laughs, and then asked, "Tell me, what's the matter." "Hehe," the girl said quickly, "That's right, that's right, Brother Feng, you don't know, there is a very annoying boy in the class who has always been at odds with me. It's summer vacation, and he keeps pestering me to send messages every day. So I made an appointment with him to fight Pokémon, and let him lose after he lost.Stop sending me messages." "Then he said he wanted to participate in the Baby Cup held by Want Want Supermarket, and said he would compete there!" "But his Pokémon is a grass-type Bulbasaur, and I'm a little afraid that I can't beat it..." Lin Feng interrupted her, "So, you want my Vine Snake to help train your Squirtle?" "That's right," Qin Shu nodded seriously."Uh..." Lin Feng complained mercilessly, "What a childish date..." Probably the boy liked Qin Shu, so he kept sending messages to Qin Shu.
